2607.28801.title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
2607.28801.paper_summary: Benchmark datasets are central to evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), yet they are typically conceived as monolithic tasks, obscuring substantial variation in the demands of individual samples. We introduce a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: 1. Cognitive and Knowledge Demands, 2. Language and Content Quality, 3. Task Properties, 4. Context, and 5. Ethics, Safety, and Fairness. Applying this framework, we annotate five influential benchmarks -- MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA -- revealing pronounced internal heterogeneity that is not captured by aggregate accuracy scores. We show how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite benchmark subsets across datasets, supporting targeted evaluation of model capabilities such as Reasoning Depth or Ethical Sensitivity. This approach reframes benchmark evaluation as dataset introspection, providing a principled methodology for analyzing and re-composing existing benchmarks to better reflect diverse evaluation needs.
2607.28801.paper_summary_zh: 基準數據集對於評估大型語言模型（LLMs）至關重要，然而它們通常被視為單一的任務，掩蓋了個別樣本需求的實質變化。<lb/>我們引入了一個以數據集為中心的元評估框架，該框架在五個潛在維度上對基準數據集進行樣本級別的審核：1. 認知和知識需求，2. 語言和內容質量，3. 任務特性，4. 上下文，以及5. 倫理、安全和公平。<lb/>應用這一框架，我們對五個有影響力的基準進行了標註——MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA——揭示了顯著的內部異質性，而這一點在總體準確率分數中並未體現。<lb/>我們展示了這些標註如何使得基於標準驅動的複合基準子集的協調成為可能，支持對模型能力的針對性評估，例如推理深度或倫理敏感性。<lb/>這一方法將基準評估重新框架為數據集內省，提供了一種原則性的方法論，用於分析和重新組合現有基準，以更好地反映多樣的評估需求。
2607.28801.author: Philipp D. Siedler et.al.
